capabilities: Copy the active note via command palette or file menu
Copy a selected folder and all its contents
disambiguation: Not a clipboard utility; it duplicates whole notes and folders within the vault rather than copying text to the system clipboard.
problem: Obsidian only offers note copying through the file explorer context menu, not as commands that can be invoked from the command palette.
summary: File duplication plugin that adds commands to copy the active note and copy a folder with all its contents.
